title: Differential banding & staffing curves (Q2 2026)
body:
Purpose:
A compact scenario sheet that ties together 1) three staffing curves (Conservative / Target / Aggressive), 2) pricing variant impacts on unit economics, and 3) triggers for hiring pauses or price adjustments. Designed to be an actionable input to the Q2 budget review and the Dedicated capacity sales forecast.

Quick takeaway (one-liner):
If we hold price constant, the Target staffing curve requires a ~9% token-price uplift or a 14% improvement in GPU cost efficiency to preserve mid-year gross margin targets; conversely, a -10% price move requires an immediate hiring slow-down under the Conservative curve.

Scenario summary (monthly run-rate snapshot, simplified):
| Scenario        | Net ARR delta (6mo) | Avg monthly burn | Runway impact (months) | Key driver |
|-----------------|---------------------:|-----------------:|-----------------------:|-----------|
| Conservative    | -$6.2M              | $5.1M            | -3                     | hiring slow |
| Target          | +$1.1M              | $5.9M            | 0                      | price / efficiency mix |
| Aggressive      | +$5.8M              | $6.8M            | +2                     | faster hires & upsell |

Assumptions used (high level):
- Base token demand growth: 12% q/q baseline, alt demand shock scenario: -18% q/q
- Price per 1k tokens (hosted avg): Base = $0.024, Upside = $0.028, Downside = $0.020
- Effective GPU cost per 1k tokens: Base = $0.011, Optimized = $0.0092 (quant + batching), Shock = $0.013
- Average fully-burdened hiring cost per new FTE (first 6 months): Eng = $135k, MLE = $150k, SRE = $140k, Sales/CS = $110k
- Typical lead time to fill role: 8 weeks (eng), 10 weeks (sre/mle), 6 weeks (sales)

Headcount curves (quarterly snapshots, FTE counts):
Conservative (minimal hires) 
| Role       | Start Q2 | Mid Q2 | End Q2 | Delta Q2 | Notes |
|------------|---------:|-------:|-------:|--------:|------:|
| Eng        | 58       | 60     | 61     | +3      | delay noncritical hires |
| MLE        | 12       | 12     | 12     | 0       | freeze except critical |
| SRE        | 10       | 10     | 10     | 0       | maintain oncall coverage |
| Sales/CS   | 18       | 19     | 20     | +2      | prioritize renewals |

Target (planned hiring mix)
| Role       | Start Q2 | Mid Q2 | End Q2 | Delta Q2 | Notes |
|------------|---------:|-------:|-------:|--------:|------:|
| Eng        | 58       | 63     | 68     | +10     | focus infra & runtime |
| MLE        | 12       | 13     | 15     | +3      | model onboarding + evals |
| SRE        | 10       | 11     | 12     | +2      | on-call expansion |
| Sales/CS   | 18       | 21     | 23     | +5      | Dedicated & enterprise push |

Aggressive (expand to capture demand)
| Role       | Start Q2 | Mid Q2 | End Q2 | Delta Q2 | Notes |
|------------|---------:|-------:|-------:|--------:|------:|
| Eng        | 58       | 66     | 76     | +18     | faster infra hires + temp agency |
| MLE        | 12       | 15     | 18     | +6      | hire MLEs for Optimize product |
| SRE        | 10       | 13     | 15     | +5      | regional ops expansion |
| Sales/CS   | 18       | 24     | 28     | +10     | add AE coverage for Dedicated |

Pricing sensitivity matrix (impact on contribution margin per 1k tokens):
- Base price $0.024 -> contribution margin = price - gpu_cost - infra_alloc - support_alloc
- Simplified example (1k token unit): Base: 0.024 - 0.011 - 0.003 - 0.002 = 0.008 (33% margin)
- Upside price $0.028 -> margin = 0.012 (43%)
- Downside price $0.020 -> margin = -0. -0.?? (0.020 - 0.013 - 0.003 - 0.002 = 0.002 -> 10%)

Trigger rules (operational rules of thumb we recommend):
1) If three consecutive weeks of token demand are >12% below baseline and gross margin per 1k tokens drops below 18%, enact Hiring Level: switch to Conservative curve and pause noncritical hiring for 30 days. Owner: VP Finance (Dana).
2) If price realization (net after discounts) slips by >7% q/q versus plan, move to mid-cycle price adjustment playbook: prioritize SKU-level price increases on low-elasticity customers and tighten new-user credits. Owner: Head of Revenue (Gareth).
3) If optimized GPU cost improvement <5% within two months of rollout, temporarily cap Aggressive hires to limit fixed-cost growth. Owner: Head of Infra (Marco).

Runway sensitivity snapshots (months of runway under different combos):
- Base price + Target curve: 14 months (status quo)
- Downside price (-10%) + Target curve: 11 months
- Downside price + Conservative curve: 13 months
- Upside price + Aggressive curve: 16 months

Key levers and actionables (priority ordered):
- Short term (0-6 weeks): tighten credit allowances for trial accounts, shift top 10 customers to committed pricing pilots, enable prefix caching higher retention for enterprise workloads (owner: Product ops).
- Medium term (6-12 weeks): deploy batching/quantization experiment to reduce GPU cost by ~15% for the top 20% heavy routes (owner: Serving runtime eng).
- People levers: re-prioritize contractor conversions in Eng to reduce immediate ramp costs; delay non-customer-facing headcount by 1 quarter under downside.

Open questions (to resolve before final Q2 budget sign-off):
- How much of the projected price increase is achievable without material churn? Need A/B pricing tests documented (GTM).
- Confirmation of GPU spot vs reserved mix across regions (Infra) — changes materially alter the model.
- Sales pipeline conversion assumptions for Dedicated commit upsell (Sales).

Next steps / owners:
- Dana: run sensitivity sweep with finance model (full P&L) and provide detailed table by 2026-04-20.
- Marco: provide regional GPU cost delta and expected rollout schedule by 2026-04-18.
- Priya: deliver GTM A/B test plan for price lift on 4 pilot accounts by 2026-04-25.

Notes / provenance:
- This sheet is derived from the Q1 hiring plan and observed token volumes (internal metrics pipeline). It is intentionally compact — detailed numbers live in the financial model (linked in "linked_artifacts").
- Use this as a decision-layer artifact for budget committee; treat numbers as directional until model rerun is completed.

Quick calculation appendix (text-only):
- Example monthly delta from a $0.004 per 1k token price move at 25B monthly tokens: delta = 25,000 (1k units) * $0.004 = $100k / month (~$1.2M annualized).
- Each incremental Eng hire (fully-burdened 6mo) increases monthly burn by approx $11k for the first 6 months (salary stocking + benefits + ramp).

Last updated: 2026-04-12 (in_review).
